service.name: Jazz band for a corporate event
service.serviceType: Jazz band for corporate events, receptions, dinners, awards nights and holiday parties in Denver
service.description: A jazz band for corporate events in Denver and Colorado, sized to the evening: a jazz duo as the doors open, a trio with brushes through dinner at conversation volume, silence through the remarks and awards, and a quartet with a horn or a voice once the program ends, on one contract with sound, an announcement microphone, a certificate of insurance and one itemised invoice.

faqs.q: What does a jazz band do at a corporate event?
faqs.a: It carries the parts of the evening where people are talking, and gets out of the way of the parts where one person is. A duo plays as the doors open and guests find each other, the trio plays dinner at a level the tables talk across, the music stops for the remarks and the awards, and the quartet plays the hour after the program when the floor opens. One band, sized to each slot.

faqs.q: Which size of jazz band does a corporate event need?
faqs.a: A reception or a dinner for up to eighty wants the duo or the trio. A ballroom of two hundred wants the trio through dinner and the quartet, with a horn or a singer out front, once the program ends. Tell us the headcount, the venue and whether the evening has a floor in it, and we'll recommend the size.

faqs.q: Can a jazz band play around a program of speeches and awards?
faqs.a: Yes, and that is most of the job at a corporate event. The band plays up to the moment, an announcement microphone is live on its own channel from sound check, and the music stops while your speaker is still steps from the stage. A walk-up for each award and a lift back into the set afterward are planned with you on the run of show.

faqs.q: Does a jazz band work for a company holiday party?
faqs.a: For the front half, yes. A jazz trio through drinks and dinner is the most common way a holiday party starts, and the question is what happens once the floor opens. A jazz quartet with a singer plays the swing and the soul end of the book for an hour, and the DJ or a covers band carries the late end through the same sound system on the same contract.

faqs.q: How much does a jazz band cost for a corporate event?
faqs.a: It depends on how many musicians play, for how long and on what date, and the market figures for a duo, a trio and a quartet are set out, sourced, in what a jazz band costs in Denver. We publish no prices of our own. Send the date and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price for that evening.

faqs.q: What do you need from us to quote it?
faqs.a: The date, the venue, the headcount and a rough shape of the evening: doors, dinner, a program, a floor or not. From that we recommend a size and send one figure with sound, load-in and strike, a certificate of insurance and a W-9 inside it, and the venue gets the footprint and power list to check line by line.
